found: Underlying bid and ask prices are included for Stocks and ETFs, but *not* for Indices by default. Customers with an active Cboe Global Indices (CGI) license (fees start at $1k/month) will receive values for indices that disseminate a distinct Bid/Ask (currently only ^SPX and ^OEX).
